reason: #939 made ChatService.continue_after_tool_callback a coroutine, but AutomationRuntimeManager._finalize_process still called the bound process terminal observer without awaiting it. When a background run_command ended without posting its results webhook (exit, timeout or cancel), the wake coroutine was dropped ('coroutine ... was never awaited'): the chat stayed in WAITING_CALLBACK until the 15 s chat schedule loop's recovery pass resumed it, and the try/except that records runtime.background_process_owner_notify_failed could never fire. Finalization now awaits the observer through call_async (coroutine wakes and plain-function test observers both work). Selected: the whole results-webhook suite, where seven tests of this path were left un-awaited by #939 (start_provider_turn, accept_results, continue_after_tool_callback, _turn_history, sync prepare_resume/start_provider_turn stubs) and failed on main; they are repaired, the producer-ends-without-callback test now proves the wake, and two new tests drive the kernel's own observer binding (create_app) and the failure-recording path; with the branch's test file, all 11 non-regression tests pass on origin/main source and the 3 regressions fail there with the never-awaited warning. Also the restart-recovery background-command cases (shutdown interrupts without waking owners, interrupted producer releases the wait, shutdown parks a driven turn) and the operator Stop case, which now binds the chat's coroutine wake like the kernel so it proves Stop is not blocked by the awaited wake (fails on main with the unraisable never-awaited warning under CI flags), and the automation-runtime cases that run, cancel, time out and finalize commands, all of which pass on origin/main.
exclusions: No full suites. No frontend, native or Playwright changes: the fix is Core-only and has no UI. Other cases of test_automation_runtime.py (7 host-mode cases), test_restart_recovery_lifecycle.py (3) and test_recovery_reconciliation.py (1-2, load-sensitive) fail identically on pristine origin/main and on this branch locally, so they are not selected; the branch adds no new failure in those files. The real-Core journey (chat run_command background=true whose process ends without its callback) cannot run on this host: the scratch Core reports runner and container_terminal unavailable (no prepared Kali runtime image), Host-mode chat commands are held behind the memory-runner/v1 gate (the temporary unmanaged-command override is restricted to one production project and was not used), and the shared stub model never calls run_command. A scratch supervisor Core from this branch was booted and served a provider chat as a smoke check only.
